implemented: Foreground-only drive session state machine: idle, requestingPermission, acquiringLocation, driving, paused and stopped.
Location stream is inactive before explicit StartDriving, while requesting permission, after pause, after stop and after permission revocation.
Permission blockers distinguish denied, denied forever, precise location off, service off and stale last-known location.
Platform invalid speed/course/accuracy sentinel values normalize to null instead of 0 or north.
Android declares only foreground coarse/fine location permissions. iOS declares When In Use location usage text only.
